name: Germany
description: The German market profile of A177 (DTVP DVB-I Implementation Profile v1.1.0, BMT testbed): only A177r6 is permitted, the programme guide needs today and the 7 days after (an error when a day is missing) and should have the 7 days before (a warning), service lists and registries have relaxed schemas, service logos are 320 pixels wide and EPG images 640, postcodes have 5 digits, DVB-S service instances have their direct tuning parameters, an Icecast service instance is audio/mpeg or audio/aac, a linked application that controls the presentation is an XML AIT with an HbbTV application, every service has a service logo, an out-of-service banner, a ServiceType, a content guide source and a service instance, every service instance has a DisplayName, every LCN table has an LCNRange for broadcast services (serviceOrigin targetBroadcast, otherBroadcast or any), every service logo is also available in the image variants 16x9_colour_light and 16x9_colour_dark, and an XML AIT in the urn:dvb:mhp:2009 namespace is not a warning (AIT006a is suppressed)
